title: A Categorical Atlas of Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning: Cones, Orbits, and Gauges
abstract: arXiv:2610.12728v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning has hundreds of methods, usually compared by parameter count and benchmark score. We compare them as maps. A pretrained checkpoint is a base point in weight space, and a weight-space method is a smooth map from a small parameter space that starts at that point. These maps form a slice category in which the frozen model is initial and full fine-tuning terminal. Three invariants of the map do most of the work. Its image near the base point governs expressivity, through the first-order image, the dimension, a min-cut bound on rank and whether that point is smooth or an apex. Its fibres, with the optimizer's metric, govern training dynamics. Base change moves the base point and covers splitting initialisations, quantisation, restarts and merging. We prove, for example, that zero-initialised LoRA, and Householder reflection adaptation at its default start under stated rank and parity conditions, begin at the ap

translated_title: 参数高效微调的范畴图册：锥、轨道与规范
translated_abstract: 参数高效微调（PEFT）已有数百种方法，通常通过参数量和基准测试分数来进行比较。我们将这些方法视为映射来比较：预训练检查点是权重空间中的一个基点，而权重空间方法是从一个小参数空间出发、以该点为起点的光滑映射。这些映射构成一个切片范畴，其中冻结模型是始对象，全量微调是终对象。该映射的三个不变量承担了大部分刻画工作：其在基点附近的像通过一阶像、维度、关于秩的最小割界，以及该点是光滑点还是顶点，决定了模型的表达能力；其纤维连同优化器的度量决定了训练动力学；基变换移动基点，并涵盖了初始化拆分、量化、重启与合并等操作。例如，我们证明零初始化的LoRA，以及在给定秩与奇偶性条件下从其默认起点出发的Householder反射适配，都从顶点开始……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一个范畴论统一框架，将数百种参数高效微调方法视为从小参数空间到权重空间的光滑映射，并通过像、纤维与基变换三个不变量统一刻画方法的表达能力、训练动力学以及量化、合并、重启等操作。
en_tdlr: This paper unifies hundreds of parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods by viewing them as smooth maps into weight space within a slice category, characterizing their expressivity, training dynamics, and operations like quantization, restarting, and merging through three map invariants: image, fibres, and base change.
